plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any other bid, bidding your value is either better or equal. If I bid less than my value, I risk losing the item to someone who values it more, but I could have won it for a price I'd be happy to pay. If I bid more than my value, I risk overpaying. Therefore, I will bid my value of $40.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more than you do, while bidding more than your value risks paying more than the item is worth to you. My value is $17, so I will bid $17.
